noveltyJustification: Live replay separates parseable routing from typed-pair resolution and exposes a sk-code-only contract failure: seven selected paths yield zero pairs after manifest cross-checking.
keyQuestions: Does parser success imply typed-pair success for each live hub?
Are the sk-code resource paths aligned with its manifest and filesystem?
answeredQuestions: sk-code replay is parseable but returns pairs=[] and seven unresolved resources.
The sk-code router emits unqualified paths while its manifest contains mode-qualified leaves; the referenced default files are absent at hub root.
The affected router, manifest, and parent lines predate 140266be3e; no equivalent unresolved contract appeared in representative replays for the other six hubs.
